stemMd: Both passages distinguish a fair permit system from one that

options.label: A
options.textMd: permits more than one kind of performer.

options.label: B
options.textMd: allows officials' artistic preferences to determine who may perform.

options.label: C
options.textMd: uses any rule to coordinate public space.

options.label: D
options.textMd: recognizes that demand can exceed available slots.

explanationMd: The first directly rejects artistic gatekeeping. The second accepts that reform and proposes changes that do not require merit judgments. Their disagreement is not about restoring official taste as the gatekeeper.

distractorRationale.e: Transparency is compatible with their recommendations.
distractorRationale.c: Both accept some allocation and regulation.
